wikipediaSummary.title: Willy and the Poor Boys
wikipediaSummary.description: 1969 studio album by Creedence Clearwater Revival
wikipediaSummary.extract: Willy and the Poor Boys is the fourth studio album by the American rock band Creedence Clearwater Revival, released on October 29, 1969, by Fantasy Records. It was the last of three studio albums the band released that year, arriving just three months after Green River. In 2020, Rolling Stone ranked the album number 193 on its list of the "500 Greatest Albums of All Time".
